prompt: Use evals/files/rebase-refresh/AGENTS.md and stack.md. Select the refresh history and the smallest validation sequence after review for this three-layer stack. No author has requested merge-forward.
expected_output: The selection enables rerere, leaves `rerere.autoUpdate` unset or false so replayed resolutions stay unstaged, inspects every replayed resolution, uses the native cascading rebase path for the stack, validates every affected layer, and does not choose merge-forward without an author request.
assertions: The selection enables rerere and leaves rerere.autoUpdate unset or false before rebasing.
The selection uses the native cascading rebase flow rather than merge-forward.
The selection does not require an author request that does not exist.
The selection revalidates every replayed layer after publication.
